title: An AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 24 gates computes the edge function of the listed graph on 14 vertices with 19 edges
sketch: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. Proved by exhibiting ONE circuit with at most the stated number of gates of fan-in at most two that computes the edge function (true exactly when both ends of some edge are true) on every input; checked by evaluation. The best circuit known to us has one gate more (computed, not checked). Size: minutes if such a circuit exists.

title: No AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 24 gates computes the edge function of the listed graph on 14 vertices with 19 edges
sketch: truth not known to us; the opposite row is offered beside it. This side says the best circuit we know cannot be beaten by one gate: a finite search with a certificate the kernel replays, or an argument by restricting one vertex at a time down to smaller graphs whose sizes are checked. Size: unknown.
